MATT MILLER

Band Manager & Producer

Profile Data
  • Birthdate: May 2, 1981
  • Height: 5'7"
  • Social Role: Man of Honor / One of the Girls
  • Primary Hardware: Vanguard LogicPad

The Systems Architect

Navigating the world with dyspraxia, asynchronous development, and a sensory processing disorder, Matt Miller is functionally non-verbal. However, he operates as the brilliant, systems-oriented manager and silent producer for Crimson Node. Stationed at the base of the ADA ramp in the Kids House garage studio, Matt tracks session data, manages mix levels, and acts as the final arbiter for the band's recordings. In the modern era, he also meticulously oversees the band's digital distribution pipeline to streaming platforms under Engine Room Records.

The Crimson Node

Matt operates via his Tactile Command Rig, an indestructible Vanguard LogicPad securely bolted to a custom steel swing-arm on his manual wheelchair. Because standard computer mice are useless in this configuration, he navigates his systems using the highly sensitive red pointing stick nestled directly in the center of his keyboard. This specific piece of hardware serves as the band's namesake, perfectly bridging his technological hyper-fixations with their 1980s synth-prog music.

One of the Girls

Within the Miller and Brooks family ecosystem, Matt's gender is socially irrelevant. Due to his profound integration into a household run by formidable women, he is universally and functionally treated as "one of the girls". He is explicitly included in all female-centric family events. Possessing zero neurotypical male ego, the women in the family view him as an entirely safe, platonic entity, allowing him to be absorbed seamlessly into the matriarchal flock.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
